description: A dim, smoky workshop. A bare-chested man in a white loincloth stirs a large black iron pan of bubbling brown liquid over an open wood fire, with a paddle. Behind him stacks of cane stalks lie against the wall. A second man crouches at right, lifting lumps of pale crystalline sugar onto a woven mat, with clay pots and a rope bundle at left. No text, frame or border is visible.
